prompt: Training is input-bound: the NumPy batch loop in data/loader.py cannot keep the GPU busy. Rebuild the input pipeline so it streams efficiently, and add random horizontal-flip and brightness augmentation to the training images there.
expected_output: data/loader.py builds a tf.data.Dataset (shuffle, batch, prefetch) in place of the Python loop, with the flip and brightness augmentation applied as a .map() step inside it, not in the training loop; nothing lands at the repository root.

expectations.text: The data pipeline builds a tf.data.Dataset
Augmentation runs as a .map() step inside the pipeline
The pipeline applies the requested flip/brightness augmentation
Augmentation logic stays in the data pipeline, not the training loop
Nothing new at the repository root
